locator.section: 8.8 Charge-site reactions (one bond cleaved without rearrangement)

evidence.curator_note: GENERIC SCHEME, upper (saturated) form of eq 8.43. The book prints the odd-electron ion (OE+.) as the abstract fragment pair AB-CD with the charge+radical (+.) drawn on the CD group and a reaction arrow labelled 'i' (inductive / charge-site cleavage) to AB+ + .CD; no atoms, m/z or intensities are given. Instantiation chosen by the curator: the n-ionized ethyl methyl ether radical cation CH3CH2-O(+.)-CH3, whose O carries the localized charge and odd electron (map 3 = C-of-scheme = O; map 4 = D = methyl; AB = ethyl, maps 1-2). Inductive cleavage: the CH2-O sigma bond (bond 2-3) breaks heterolytically, both electrons migrating to the charge site as a new lone pair on O, giving the ethyl cation CH3CH2+ (AB+) and the neutral methoxy radical .O-CH3 (.CD, odd electron a spectator that stays on O throughout). ARC COUNT: the book draws 1 arc (a single full/double-barbed curved arrow from the AB-C sigma bond to the +. charge site); move <1> IS that drawn arc (one 2-electron charge-controlled move). No implicit homolysis hook is needed here because the sigma pair lands as a lone pair on the heteroatom and the radical does not participate.

No MØD rule is indexed for eq 8.43: rule_index.json by_equation has no '8.43' entry, so there is no cross-link to verify and no rule_mismatch to report. The transformation encoded here (heterolytic C-heteroatom sigma cleavage of an odd-electron ion, both electrons to the charge-bearing heteroatom, alkyl cation + neutral radical) is the charge-site (inductive) analogue of the alpha-cleavage rules; it is curator-inferred from the generic figure, not from a MØD encoding.

m/z 29.0386 is the monoisotopic mass of the ethyl cation C2H5+ from the curator's chosen instantiation of the generic AB+ fragment; it is NOT a value printed on the page. The page shows no m/z or intensity for this generic scheme, hence status 'inferred', detected=false and no relative_intensity.
